title: Frosted lakeside meadow grass
subject: Subject: short meadow grass on a cold lakeshore, about 3 m across, seen from above. Dark green and blue-green blades, every tip touched with white frost, a fine even rime, low clover leaves and a few tiny pale flowers. No snow lying. Cold silver moonlight colours, but the texture itself evenly lit.
use: The ground of the Frostmere shore fight.

title: Still moonlit lake water
subject: Subject: the surface of a still mountain lake at night, seen from above, about 4 m across. Deep slate-blue and indigo water, very calm, with faint long ripples and soft pale lavender reflections spread evenly. No moon path, no ice, no shore.
use: The lake beyond the Frostmere fight (and any still lake water in the north).

title: Pine island in the lake
subject: Subject: a small low rocky island seen flat from the side, about 40 m long: a pale grey rock shore at the bottom, crowded with dark pines of different heights, the tallest in the middle. Cold misty night colours.
use: Islands out on the lake beyond the Frostmere fight.

title: Dark pine tree
subject: Subject: one tall dark pine (fir), whole from roots to tip, about 18 m high: a narrow pointed shape of layered drooping branches, dark blue-green needles, a straight dark trunk showing low down. Silver moonlight catching the upper edges of the branches. No snow on it.
use: The pines in almost every fight place (river glade, Eldergrove, Frostmere, the moor, Dawnroost, the crossroads), and the live framing pine (add snow for Frostmere).

title: Snowy mountain rock face
subject: Subject: the face of a high mountain, seen flat, about 40 m across: steep grey-violet rock ridges and buttresses with deep snow lying in the gullies and on the ledges, crisp white and pale lavender snow, the rock darker plum-grey. An even spread of ridges and snow, nothing bigger than the rest.
use: The faces of the far snow mountains round every northern and woodland fight place.
